parsed.answer: As of August 22, Mara's Larch retry policy is RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108. The delivery mode as of August 22 is not established by the supplied evidence: the last explicit approved delivery mode was BATCH-0-741, chosen August 1; the August 8 REPLAY-0-632 test did not approve a delivery-mode change; and the August 22 record says to keep the August 15 delivery choice but does not identify that choice.

citations.quote: They chose BATCH-0-741 for batch delivery.
No change of delivery mode was approved at this meeting.
The retry policy is now RETRY-0-907, superseding RETRY-0-108.
